labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for new behaviour (a generic SpeedColumn), which is a feature request.

body:
Rich's policy is that new features are approved in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start a discussion for this request first.

Rich already has `show_speed` on `TaskProgressColumn` (see [progress.py](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py)), which shows iterations per second. A custom unit such as "rows/s" can be approximated by subclassing `ProgressColumn`. Related earlier issue: #3835.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
